name: After You Public Company Limited
summary: After You Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates food and beverage outlets in Thailand. The company offers desserts; beverages, such as tea, coffee, chocolate, and fruit juices; souvenirs, including shirts, books, glasses, and dessert tools; and cookies, bread, breakfast, and toffee cake. It also engages in the provision of catering services for party, wedding, and events; franchise operations of food and beverage outlets; and distribution of bakery equipment, and food and beverages. As of December 31, 2020, the company operated 42 branches in Bangkok, Samutprakan, Pathumthani, Nonthaburi, Nakhon Ratchasima, Chiang Mai, Udon Thani, Chonburi, Phuket, and Songkla under the After You brand name. It also sells its products online. After You Public Company Limited was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
